verdict.rationale: Kosmos and related agents (Literature, Precedent) are documented as autonomously reading literature, writing/executing analysis code, forming and testing hypotheses, and producing comprehensive cited reports rather than a single-pass summary, with auditability of findings back to sources. Client docs show task submission/polling workflows (create_task, run_tasks_until_done) consistent with multi-step autonomous jobs. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of multi-step autonomy (all evidence is vendor docs), and no concrete example trace showing intermediate steps of an investigation.
